title: Read ID3 metadata with AVAsset
description: Use AVAsset to extract title, artist, album, and duration when adding tracks.

title: Display metadata in UI
description: Show Artist - Title format in playlist rows and player controls.
close_reason: Updated PlayerControlsView and TrackRow to use displayName

title: System-style multi-select highlighting
description: Add proper system selection highlighting to playlist like Finder/file pickers, not just a custom indicator.

title: Clear stale tracks from database
description: Add ability to clear tracks with invalid/stale file URLs from previous sessions.

title: Player controls UI
description: Create compact player control bar with play/pause toggle, stop, previous track, and next track buttons. Show current track info.

title: Add selected track visual indicator
description: Playlist shows playing indicator but not selection indicator for single-clicked tracks.

title: Track and Playlist SwiftData models
description: Create SwiftData models for Track (file URL, title, duration, order) and playlist management. Replace the template Item model.

title: Add metadata fields to Track model
description: Add artist, album, and duration fields to Track model.

title: Play/pause button state
description: Play button should visually toggle to pause icon while a track is playing.

title: Playlist UI with drag-and-drop
description: Create playlist view showing tracks in order. Support drag-and-drop to add files and reorder tracks. Double-click to play.

title: Compact window configuration
description: Configure app window for minimal footprint - small default size, appropriate min/max constraints, clean title bar.

title: Move playing indicator to right column
description: Move speaker icon to fixed-width right column in playlist rows. Text should truncate before the indicator.

title: Fix previous/next track buttons
description: Previous and next buttons in player controls don't change the song.

title: Minimal Audio Player (Winamp-style)
description: Build a minimal, Winamp-inspired audio player for macOS. Features: compact player controls (play/pause/stop/previous/next), small playlist with drag-and-drop support, sequential playback. Built with SwiftUI and AVFoundation.
close_reason: MVP complete: drag-drop playlist, playback controls, progress bar, track persistence with bookmarks, auto-advance, compact window styling

title: Persist file access across sessions with bookmarks
description: Playlist tracks persist in SwiftData but can't be played after app restart due to sandbox. Need to save security-scoped bookmarks and resolve them on launch.

title: Audio playback engine (AVFoundation)
description: Create AudioPlayer class using AVFoundation/AVAudioPlayer to handle audio file playback. Support play, pause, stop, and track completion detection.

title: Handle deleting currently playing track
description: When removing a track that's currently playing: stop playback, clear current track state, reset seek bar, then remove from playlist.

title: Auto-advance to next track on song end
description: When a song finishes playing, should automatically start the next track in the playlist.

title: Progress indicator bar
description: Add a progress bar above the player controls showing current playback position and track duration.

title: Fix broken audio playback
description: Playback stopped working after AudioPlayer refactor for observable state.

title: Fix playlist item deletion
description: Cannot delete items from the playlist - delete functionality not working.

title: ID3 metadata support
description: Read and display ID3 metadata (title, artist, album, duration) from audio files instead of just filenames.
close_reason: ID3 metadata support complete - reads artist, album, title, duration via AVAsset

title: Playlist selection highlighting
description: Add visual selection state to playlist so user can see which track was last clicked, not just which is playing.

title: Enhanced track row layout
description: Redesign TrackRow to show: playlist number (left), track title, artist, and (track#, album) in parens. Use flexible SwiftUI layout rather than rigid columns so rows adapt to content.
close_reason: Enhanced track row layout with playlist #, title, artist, and (track#, album)
